scope: Local static review only, no compilation, no remote actions, no GPU access
checks: Diagnostic ID atomic increment changes only the new tracing counter and stored ID; no mapping address/size/flags changed.
WINDOW_CREATE accesses memArea range after numRanges==1 guard and before free; destroy logs precede pMap free.
RM_PTE logs the first PTE after final encoding and copies no new data into the PTE. Decode helpers read the format/data only.
nv_dma_use_map_resource added call only reads current DMA-ops/flag; DMA result/control flow unchanged.
DMA log resource/BDF accesses occur after existing resource validation. NvU64 matches %llx/%llu in target Linux source; numRanges is NvU64.
UVM raw PTE second word guarded by entry>=16, first word by num_ptes!=0; logged table_pa is table destination, not transfer target.
UVM submission/wait calls and cleanup sequencing unchanged; logs report existing statuses.
Builder verifies stock/baseline/instrumented hashes and refuses existing output; only make modules, no modules_install or loading.
limitations: Diagnostic logging and larger private tracking object change timing and allocation layout.
Readback of installed hardware page tables and PCIe TLP capture are not provided.
Historical dynamic binary is not claimed byte-identical to reconstructed sources.
